note: The exact weld of each binary STL: its vertex and triangle counts and an FNV-1a digest of its positions (f32) and triangles (u32), little-endian. Held by packages/geom/tests/weld_parity.rs (the engine) and packages/app/test/stl-weld-parity.test.ts (the app). SX_WELD_RECORD=1 cargo test -p sx-geom --test weld_parity writes it again.
